solver: scikit-fem linear elasticity assembly, SciPy SuperLU; C3D4-equivalent (not CalculiX executable)

physical_groups.2:6: fully fixed face 6, centroid [-127.5,0,0], area 100 mm2
physical_groups.2:38: face 38, centroid [127.5,0,0], area 100 mm2; uniform traction [0,2,0] N/mm2

modeling_assumptions: Full supplied 3D solid in original mm frame, no dimensional reduction.
Linear isotropic small displacement, no gravity.
First order tetrahedra, constant strain and stress.
Fully fixed nodes on face 6 including its boundary. Consistent surface traction on all face 38 triangles.
Reported mesh maximum size 2 mm, minimum 0.5 mm. No accuracy claim beyond source linear model.

field_schema.mapping: Arrays use ascending Gmsh node_ids. element_ids and tetrahedra_node_ids preserve original Gmsh tags in mesh.msh; element arrays have same row order as element_ids. No node or element renumbering in exported mesh.
field_schema.tetrahedra_node_ids: (T,4) Gmsh node IDs, not zero-based indices
field_schema.nodal_stress_MPa: (N,3,3) symmetric Cauchy tensor, averaged element tensors
field_schema.nodal_principal_MPa: (N,3) ascending principal stresses; last is major
field_schema.nodal_max_shear_MPa: (N,) half principal range, NOT full Tresca equivalent stress
field_schema.reaction_N: (N,3) K*u-f, includes roundoff residual on free nodes

quantity_extraction.max_displacement_mm: Maximum Euclidean norm of nodal displacements
quantity_extraction.max_von_mises_MPa: Maximum von Mises invariant of the equal-weight average of incident tetrahedral stress tensors
quantity_extraction.max_shear_stress_MPa: Maximum half-difference of major and minor principal nodal stress
quantity_extraction.max_principal_MPa: Maximum major principal value of recovered nodal stress

limitations: CalculiX not present. Equivalent linear tetrahedral equations solved independently; mesh/version and nodal recovery differences can alter extrema.
